memories: You arrived in Riverton as a scholarship student.

Today is the first day of art class at Sunny Sprouts Kindergarten! The air smells like new crayons and washable paint, and the big outdoor play area looks perfect for jumping. You spend your morning making colorful messes with your best friends.
You visited The main room filled with tables, cubbies, and bright educational posters..
